sanskrit: gāto havir janayan tastha indra- -agraṃ jyeṣṭha pary agāmeha deva | sa gāto gātottamā payāpim asmabhyam indra dadataḥ pracetaḥ ||
english: O Indra, the Gātu stood generating the oblation; O elder foremost, O god, you have come around here. That Gātu, best of paths, pours forth the flood of milk — give it to us, O Indra, O Pracetas.

sanskrit: agnir naḥ puraetāstv añjasā bṛhaspatiḥ sanyāstu naḥ sakhā | indraṃ huve vṛtrahaṇaṃ purandaraṃ bhagenādya bhagavantaḥ syāma ||
english: May Agni go before us straightway; may Bṛhaspati be our ally and companion. I invoke Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, the breaker of strongholds — may we today, through Bhaga's grace, be endowed with fortune.

sanskrit: tvaṃ soma divyo nṛcakṣāḥ sugām̐ asmabhyaṃ patho anu khyaḥ | abhi no gotraṃ viduṣa iva neṣo 'cchā no vācam uśatīṃ jigāsi ||
english: You, O Soma, divine and all-seeing of men, look out for us along the path to good cattle. Lead our clan as one who knows the way; come forth to meet our eager speech.

sanskrit: imām agne śaraṇiṃ mīmṛṣo na imam adhvānaṃ yam agāma dūram | āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānāṃ bhṛmir asy ṛṣikṛn martyānām ||
english: O Agni, do not abandon this shelter, nor this road we have traveled so far. You are the kinsman and father, the guardian of the soma-drinkers; you are the Bhṛmi, the maker of seers among mortals.

sanskrit: ye purastād āsyandete gāvau svaṛṣabhe iva | kṛṇomy arvaṇī aham aśvavārād aṇīyasī ||
english: Those two that drip and flow from the east, like two cows on their own bull — I make those two mares thinner than a horse's hair.

sanskrit: ye adharād āsyandete gāvau svaṛṣabhe iva | kṛṇomy arvaṇī aham aśvavārād aṇīyasī ||
english: Those two that drip and flow from below, like two cows on their own bull — I make those two mares thinner than a horse's hair.

sanskrit: ye paścād āsyandete gāvau svaṛṣabhe iva | kṛṇomy arvaṇī aham aśvavārād aṇīyasī ||
english: Those two that drip and flow from the west, like two cows on their own bull — I make those two mares thinner than a horse's hair.

sanskrit: ye uttarād āsyandate gāvau svaṛṣabhe iva | kṛṇomy arvaṇī aham aśvavārād aṇīyasī ||
english: Those two that drip and flow from the north, like two cows on their own bull — I make those two mares thinner than a horse's hair.

sanskrit: agne yaśasvin yaśasā vardhayemam indrāvatīm upacitim ihā vaha | ayaṃ mūrdhā parameṣṭhī suvarcāḥ samānānām uttamaśloko astu ||
english: O glorious Agni, increase this man with glory; bring here the Indra-endowed accumulation of wealth. May this head of the assembly, Parameṣṭhin, of brilliant radiance, be the most celebrated among his peers.

sanskrit: dhātā vidhartā paramota saṃdṛk prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhī virāṭ | stomāś chandāṃsi nivido ma āhus te asmai rāṣṭram upa saṃ namantu ||
english: Dhātā, Vidhātā, the supreme Saṃdṛk, Prajāpati, Parameṣṭhin, Virāṭ — the stoma-hymns, the meters, the nivid-formulas speak thus to me: let them all bow down together to this man's sovereignty.

sanskrit: bhadram icchanta ṛṣayaḥ svarvidas tapo dīkṣām upa ni ṣedur agre | tato rāṣṭraṃ balam ojaś ca jātaṃ tad asmai devā upa saṃ namantu ||
english: Desiring the auspicious, the seers, knowers of the heavenly world, sat down at the beginning in tapas and dīkṣā. From that were born sovereignty, strength, and vital force — may the gods direct all of that toward this man.

sanskrit: upā vartadhvam upa na eta sarve 'yaṃ cettādhipatir vo astu samānaṃ mantram abhi mantrayādhvā imaṃ paścād upa jīvātha sarve ||
english: Come together, all of you draw near; let this one who perceives be your overlord. Take counsel together with the same sacred formula; henceforth all of you shall live in dependence upon him.
